revision_notes: Confirmed. Cape Verde's general Data Protection Law 133/V/2001 (amended by Law 41/VIII/2013 and Law 121/IX/2021, in force 2021) is a comprehensive GDPR-style regime covering all personal data, including financial/credit data, and is explicitly incorporated by reference into 2018 payment-institution and e-money regulations (Decree 9/2018, Art.5) and digital bank rules issued by Banco de Cabo Verde. No dedicated payment-specific data provisions exist, so the general-legislation code (2) is correct; single-source flag resolved with two additional authoritative sources (CNPD primary law text, national payments regulation).
